original_ai_output.title_zh: 旱季来临：尼日利亚联邦首都区居民对火灾隐患、高温与健康风险表达担忧
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 随着旱季逐渐到来，尼日利亚联邦首都区（FCT）居民对火灾隐患、恶劣天气和健康问题表示担忧。居民指出，气温升高、沙尘风以及电力供应不足使日常生活日益困难，部分人出现呼吸道不适等与天气相关的疾病。居民还提到，因电力不足，一些家庭夜间露天睡觉或门窗敞开，增加了治安和环境风险。他们呼吁改善供电并加强社区治安巡查。

key_facts.fact: 联邦首都区居民对旱季火灾隐患、恶劣天气和健康风险表达担忧
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: residents of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT) are expressing concerns over increasing fire hazards, harsh weather conditions and health-related challenges

key_facts.fact: 居民称气温升高、沙尘风和电力不足使日常生活更加困难
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: many residents say rising temperatures, dusty winds and inadequate electricity supply are making daily life increasingly difficult

key_facts.fact: 部分居民报告出现呼吸道不适、卡他症状、咳嗽等与天气相关的疾病
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Some residents also report experiencing weather-related illnesses, including respiratory discomfort, catarrh, cough and other ailments

key_facts.fact: 居民称许多社区每天供电不足六小时
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: many communities, particularly those on the outskirts of the city centre, experience prolonged power outages, sometimes receiving fewer than six hours of electricity daily

key_facts.fact: 有居民称部分家庭因高温露天睡觉或夜间门窗敞开，增加治安与环境风险
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: some families reportedly resort to sleeping outdoors or leaving their doors and windows open at night to enjoy fresh air

uncertainties: 居民所述供电不足、露天睡觉及健康问题均为居民个人反映，尚未获得独立核实
露天睡觉导致盗窃、蛇咬等风险为居民担忧，未报告具体事件
